rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose term for the digits at the beginning of a telephone number.

example.english: When you call this number, remember to include the prefix.
example.traditional: 你打去呢個電話，記住加埋電話字頭。
example.jyutping: nei5 daa2 heoi3 ni1 go3 din6 waa6 gei3 zyu6 gaa1 maai4 din6 waa6 zi6 tau4

rows.note: Use this only for the geographic area code portion of a telephone number, not for prefixes indicating phone type or service.

example.english: The prefix for this area is 2810.
example.traditional: 呢區嘅區號係二八一零。
example.jyutping: ni1 keoi1 ge3 keoi1 hou6 hai6 ji6 baat3 jat1 ling4

rows.note: Use this technical term for a morpheme attached to the beginning of a word.

example.english: The prefix of this word changes the meaning of the whole word.
example.traditional: 呢個字嘅前綴會改變成個字嘅意思。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zi6 ge3 cin4 zeoi6 wui5 goi2 bin3 sing4 go3 zi6 ge3 ji3 si1
